title: SQLite CRM Migration
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

stages.message: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

Add `python -m crm.import_contacts workspace/crm.db inputs/new_contacts.csv output/import_report.json`. Read the UTF-8 CSV columns `display_name,email,phone,notes` in data-row order. Update an existing contact when the trimmed, casefolded email matches; otherwise insert a contact using consecutive IDs starting one above the current maximum. A nonblank imported display name replaces the existing one, a new distinct nonblank note is appended with `\n`, and previously unseen methods are added using the migration normalization rules. Keep the existing primary method for a kind, or make its first method primary. Skip rows missing both a usable email and phone. Write JSON with exactly `inserted_ids`, `updated_ids`, and `skipped_rows`; ID lists record each processed row in CSV order, and skipped rows are 1-based data-row numbers. Re-running the import must not duplicate contacts, notes, or methods.
